name: Retained-State Update Law v1
purpose: Define the compact retained-state update object forced by RAG-0 finite-capacity conserved-current law, ordered composition, and target-blind action residuals.

closed: minimal retained finite-capacity action ledger family
compact Markov update form under ordered composition
target-blind local action residual from declared finite-capacity law family

types.retained_state: rho_n in R = compact edge/local retained action state at ordered slice n
types.finite_capacity_law: d f_n = b_n ; f_n = c_n ⊙ sigma((a_n ⊙ d*phi_n)/c_n)

law_family.P_G: gauge / representation projection preserving admissible retained-order equivalence
law_family.no_target_leakage: ell_n is computed from current ordered slice before future target scoring

necessity_statement.theorem: Under RAG-0, if the retained state is compact, target-blind, generated from local finite-capacity action residuals, and compositional under ordered-slice concatenation, then the update must be a monoid homomorphism from slice increments into retained state. In the minimal vector representation, this is additive up to gauge.
necessity_statement.what_is_unique: the additive/monoid update form and local finite-capacity action-residual family
necessity_statement.what_is_not_unique: choice of sigma within Sigma, projection gauge P_G, repair/coupling law from rho to future a/c/operator

non_smuggling_controls: rho update computed before target future transport solve

why_L_sigma.origin: convex action potential associated with finite-capacity constitutive law sigma
why_L_sigma.stationarity: finite-capacity flow solves conservation-compatible stationarity of declared action
why_L_sigma.nonlinearity_measure: L_sigma is zero at zero pressure and increases with finite-capacity stress under monotone sigma
why_L_sigma.target_blind: depends only on current slice pressure x_n and declared sigma

open_next_object.name: ROC-1 retained-operator coupling law
open_next_object.required: derive how rho_n lawfully modifies future operator/capacity/conductance/accessibility without smuggling provenance force
